Lake Oulujärvi is Kainuu's own sea. The wonderful islands and sandy beaches of the hiking area attract boaters and canoers, and Manamansalo can also be reached by car. Oulujärvi Hiking Area is part of Rokua Geopark and UNESCO's international Geopark network.
Large open stretches of water and countless sandy beaches
Manamansalo trails suitable for day trips and a path on Kuosto island
Excellent possibilities for paddling and boating
Fishing in the open waters of the lake and in esker ponds
Boat harbour and docks make landing easy
Nature of Oulujärvi Hiking Area
At the Oulujärvi Hiking Area, you’ll encounter the rugged beauty of Kainuu’s sea. The cries of gulls and terns create a maritime atmosphere.
Visitor's checklist
Everyman’s Right apply in the hiking area
Temporary camping in the area is allowed
Overnight at the cruise port is allowed
Make campfires only in designated sites
Remember to bring a trash bag
›
Always keep pets on a leash
